anchors.a: Causal Script — deterministic exoskeleton; every state change replays from a recorded cause
anchors.b: Lossy Trace — post-hoc reconstruction; state is inferred from surviving artifacts

rival_predictions.a: A regression reproduces byte-identically from the recorded cause chain on a clean checkout
rival_predictions.b: A regression reproduces only probabilistically and needs human re-derivation of trigger state

probe.cmd: nix develop .#quiet --command python prompt_foo.py --chop IDEATION_CHOP --no-tree | sha256sum
probe.observes: whether an identical compile reproduces the same payload hash from cause alone

verdict.why: Distinguishes the deterministic-context thesis from ordinary log-scraping; predicts an observable (hash reproducibility), so it charges rent
